description: Flaky harness-windows integration test (PR 20 run 40878131007 failed, the push run 40878099563 on the same commit c0a2389 passed): `hang watchdog` asserts runs\<utc>_hang\hang.txt as soon as the game process has exited, but Handle-Hang in harness/core/watcher.ps1 calls Kill-Game before it writes hang.txt. Fix both sides: the watcher writes hang.txt before the kill and rewrites it with the kill result after; the test waits for the `HANG handled` log line (the real completion signal) before asserting on the run folder. Proof: the test passes 10 runs in a row on the Windows runner. Check the other harness tests for the same exit-then-assert pattern.
title: Hang watchdog test race on hang.txt
